usageNotes: This endpoint upgrades an HTTP GET request to a WebSocket connection carrying VNC traffic for an LXC container console. It must be called immediately after `post_nodes_node_lxc_vmid_vncproxy`, using the port and vncticket values returned by that call — the ticket is short-lived and single-use. The client must perform the WebSocket upgrade on the same connection; this is not a standard REST call and cannot be used with a plain HTTP client.

examples.summary: Open VNC WebSocket for LXC container 101 on node pve1 using ticket from a prior vncproxy call

tips: Always call post_nodes_node_lxc_vmid_vncproxy first — this endpoint is the second step of a two-step handshake.
The vncticket is tied to the session and expires quickly; complete the WebSocket upgrade immediately after obtaining it.
Port is always in the range 5900–5999; use the exact value returned by vncproxy, not a hardcoded default.
The caller requires VM.Console permission on /vms/{vmid}; API tokens are accepted if that privilege is granted.
noVNC and other browser-based VNC clients expect this WebSocket endpoint — pass the ticket as a query parameter, not in the Authorization header.
